87:t_2:35.en:
$$ランド$$
「Knowing them, I don't think we need to worry.」

87:t_2:37.en:
$$マオ$$
「Just looking at him makes me feel unbearably hot!」

87:t_2:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「The only saving grace is that the Captain isn't here.」

87:t_2:39.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Your Heat Smile is in top form, $$ランド$$.」

87:t_2:41.en:
$$メール$$
「Now, let's introduce ourselves to everyone we haven't met.」

87:t_2:42.en:
$$メール$$
「I'm $$メール・ビーター$$. I handle sales and accounting for the traveling repair outfit, $$ビーター・サービス$$.」

87:t_2:43.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm $$ランド・トラビス$$. People call me $$ザ・ヒート$$.」

87:t_2:46.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Just how much of an outlaw are you...?」

87:t_2:47.en:
$$ランド$$
「Explaining that would take a while, so I'll save it for later...」

87:t_2:48.en:
$$メール$$
「For the record, I'm 17. My darling and I are only a little over ten years apart.」

87:t_2:50.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Could you be... that girl whose 《$$時が止まった$$》, from the rumors?」

87:t_2:51.en:
$$メール$$
「That's in the past. Now I'm growing up normally and healthily.」

87:t_2:52.en:
$$クルツ$$
(So that baby face and flat chest are natural...?)

87:t_2:53.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
(In a way, it's a mystery of the human body...)

87:t_2:54.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I'm $$ロラン・セアック$$, the $$ホワイトドール$$'s pilot.」

87:t_2:56.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's the name of the mechanical doll I pilot. Apparently, its real name is $$ターンエー$$.」

87:t_2:57.en:
$$マオ$$
(So that's the Turn-type mobile suit I've heard about...)

87:t_2:58.en:
$$マオ$$
(I heard its 《$$月光蝶$$》 system once destroyed the civilizations of the worlds that made up $$ＵＣＷ$$. We'd better be careful with it.)

87:t_2:61.en:
$$ティファ$$
「Lady $$ディアナ$$ of the Moon entrusted the $$ホワイトドール$$ to $$ロラン$$ because he would use its power properly.」

87:t_2:62.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$ディアナ・ソレル$$... She rules the $$ムーンレィス$$.」

87:t_2:63.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I understand how terrifying the $$月光蝶$$ is, too. That's precisely why I want to use the $$ホワイトドール$$ to do what's right.」

87:t_2:64.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well... He protected us from that scorpion bastard's poison today. We should be fine leaving it to him.」

87:t_2:65.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's right. We'll be counting on you, $$ロラン$$.」

87:t_2:67.en:
$$オズマ$$
「...It's not a satisfying ending, but we've broken $$サイデリアル$$'s chain of command on the $$アメリア$$ Continent.」

87:t_2:68.en:
$$オズマ$$
「And with their main force on $$蒼の地球$$ now, let's leave the rest to the local resistance.」

87:t_2:70.en:
$$オズマ$$
「As planned, we've defeated $$サイデリアル$$ on $$翠の地球$$ and strengthened our forces.」

87:t_2:71.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We'll return to $$蒼の地球$$, join the other units, and challenge the $$新地球皇国$$ to a decisive battle.」

87:t_2:73.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's the nation $$サイデリアル$$ built on $$蒼の地球$$. It controls most of the planet.」

87:t_2:74.en:
$$宗介$$
「They've installed $$レイライン$$s on $$蒼の地球$$ just as on $$翠の地球$$, extracting $$次元力$$.」

87:t_2:75.en:
$$レド$$
「$$次元力$$... That is the energy $$サイデリアル$$ uses.」

87:t_2:76.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ガロード$$, $$レド$$, $$ロラン$$... and $$ランド$$. Will you come with us?」

87:t_2:78.en:
$$メール$$
「I can't forgive $$サイデリアル$$ for suddenly coming from space and doing whatever they please.」

87:t_2:79.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Unless we kick them off $$蒼の地球$$, the fighting on $$翠の地球$$ won't end, either.」

87:t_2:80.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I feel the same way. Please let me help.」

87:t_2:81.en:
$$宗介$$
「Will you come with us, $$レド$$?」

87:t_2:83.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Let's go, $$レド$$. We decided to see the wider world.」

87:t_2:84.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Heh... We're finally going into space. I'll brag to everyone when we get back to the fleet.」

87:t_2:86.en:
$$レド$$
「Major $$オズマ$$, I'll accompany you as well.」

87:t_2:88.en:
$$レド$$
「Yes. I'm a member of this unit now, too.」

87:t_2:89.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll fulfill that responsibility, regardless of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

87:t_2:90.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Understood. Thank you for your cooperation.」

87:t_2:91.en:
$$ランド$$
「...By the way, where's the pilot of that blue robot I saved?」

87:t_2:92.en:
$$宗介$$
「$n's in the medical room. They're checking the effects of that scorpion's poison.」

87:t_2:94.en:
$$アルト$$
「He's on your mind after all?」

87:t_2:96.en:
$$ランド$$
(What $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ said when we parted... The $$いがみ合う双子$$ will save us...)

87:t_2:97.en:
$$ランド$$
(What did he mean by that...?)

87:t_10:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you're the famous $$ＡＧ$$. You're really well made...」

87:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Please don't let your inner impulses drive you to rip off my casing.」

87:t_10:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Are you trying to provoke me?」

87:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Heavens, no. I know nothing good comes of angering $$ザ・ヒート$$.」

87:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now is the time to endure, $$ランド$$. $$ガンレオン$$ is waiting for the right moment.」

87:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I am in charge of $$ジェニオン$$'s maintenance, after all. I've come to understand a little about the $$スフィア$$s, too.」

87:t_10:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「...It's pathetic. I've worked on machines all my life as a repairman, yet I don't understand my own.」

87:t_10:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$ガンレオン$$ is certainly more powerful than before when it enters Magna Mode...」

87:t_10:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「But there's one last thing I just can't get working... Is the problem with me, or with it...?」

87:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... If you don't mind, could I take a look at $$ガンレオン$$?」

87:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「D-Don't worry! I won't add a 2,000 mm cannon, a Tera Beam Rifle, or a Zankokutou.」

87:t_10:17.en:
$$ランド$$
「...All right, $$ＡＧ$$. At this point, I'll take any clue I can get. Give me a hand.」

87:t_10:19.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then I'll go take care of a little business. See you later.」
